verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain, its own SCA product, claims to support enforcement of open source package licensing requirements, and it builds a full dependency inventory and SBOM. That inventory is the base for license detection. The only license evidence is one overview-level line, with no detail on how licenses are detected, how policies are configured, or how scans block on violations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of license detection per dependency, license policy configuration (allow/deny lists), in-scan or CI enforcement behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can detect the licenses of my dependencies and enforce a license policy in scans

citations.quote: Support the enforcement of your business’ open source package licensing requirements
Supply Chain's Dynamic Dependency Resolution provides a complete inventory of your project's dependencies using a combination of manifest parsing and repository integration
Generate reports and software bills of materials (SBOM) that provide a complete inventory of your open source components
